# Excelsior — The Literary Club of IET Lucknow

> Excelsior is the official literary, debating, and creative writing society of the Institute of Engineering and Technology (IET), Lucknow. Established on August 27, 2014, Excelsior serves as a premier collegiate platform for poetry, prose, debating, campus journalism, and literary publications in both English and Hindi.

## Core Hubs
- [Publications](https://www.excelsioriet.in/publications): Original student and alumni essays, stories, poetry, and critiques.
- [Editor's Shelf](https://www.excelsioriet.in/editors-shelf): Curated literary reviews and book recommendations.
- [Events & Competitions](https://www.excelsioriet.in/events): Annual debates, poetry slams, open mics, and literary fests.
- [Community & Directory](https://www.excelsioriet.in/community/members): The coordinators, editorial board, and active members of the society.
- [Alumni Network](https://www.excelsioriet.in/community/alumni): The network of Excelsior alumni scattered globally across academia and industry.
- [Society Library](https://www.excelsioriet.in/community/library): The lending library catalog of physical and digital volumes maintained by the society.

## Institutional Heritage & Context
- College: Institute of Engineering and Technology (IET), Lucknow
- Campus Location: Sitapur Road, Lucknow, Uttar Pradesh, India 226021
- Founding Date: August 27, 2014
- Core Traditions: Professo (verbal articulation and debate), Ink Blot (creative prose and poetry auditions).
- Languages: English and Hindi
- Official College Hub: https://iethub.org/clubs/10
- Email: excelsior@ietlucknow.ac.in
- Social Profiles:
  - Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/iet.excelsior/
  - LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/company/excelsior-iet-lucknow/
